en.html:
Sayo"...Oh. What a delightful guest."
Sayo"The Holy See does have patience. Not one of the knights sent to destroy me has returned—and still, another knight."
Sayo"From the East this time, by the look of you? ...Hehe. I think I shall be well entertained..."

さよ「教皇庁は本当に根気があるのね。 　討伐に差し向けた騎士は皆ことごとく帰ら なかったというのに――また新たな騎士を」
さよ「見たところ、今度は東洋の御方かしら？ 　……ふふ。愉しませて頂けそうね……」

en.html:
...To tell the truth, by then I already knew.

Wrong choice.
Full failure.

No need to ask Muramasa, who had fallen silent. The force pulling me back to my proper time and place had already been cut off.

When the owner of that voice noticed me.
When those inhuman eyes, the eyes of a basilisk, settled on me as prey.

...Muramasa and I would now have to go through hardships I could not begin to imagine. Discover a way to travel through time, then find our way back where we belonged. Just thinking of how much searching that would take made my head spin.

And before we could even BEGIN that endless struggle?

First, survive.

A fight to the death.

Such grace, such elegance. An armoured warrior in front of her, and not a trace of fear—she was licking her lips. This strange noblewoman, whose name I did not know, carried the smell of fresh blood.
Before I could even begin to despair, I had to survive this bloody woman!

ja.html:
……実を言えば。
　この時点で俺はもう気付いていた。

　間違えた、
　失敗したのだ、と。

　沈黙する村正に、<ruby>質<rt>ただ</rt></ruby>す必要もない。
　俺を本来の正しい時空間へ引き戻す力は、既に断ち
切られた……。

　声の主が俺を認めた時に。

　その、人ならぬ<ruby>魔獣<rt>バジリコク</rt></ruby>の眼差しが、
　獲物として、俺を見定めた瞬間に。

　……俺と村正はこれから、想像を絶する艱難辛苦に
身を浸さなくてはなるまい。
　時間移動の方法を解明し、正しい時空間へ戻る――
どれ程の探究が求められるのか、思うだけで目が眩む。

　そして。
　その果てしない苦難の道へ踏み出すためには。
　
　まず――生き延びなくてはならない。

　死闘を。

　優美な肢体。優雅な風貌。甲鉄で装った武者を前に
して恐れ気なく舌を舐めずる――この名も知れぬ鮮血
の匂いに満ちた妖しき貴婦人の魔手から逃れなければ、
　絶望すら始まらないのだ！

Sayo"Come, knight of the East. Let us open the performance—the long night of Csejte Castle!"
Sayo"A night that never ends, with no dawn to interrupt us! Let us spend it in magnificent madness...!"
